parameters.name: CheckProgressId
parameters.description: The unique ID for querying the progress of batch device authorization.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
Enterprise instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- For new public instances or Enterprise Edition instances, Enterprise instance has an ID value. You must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- For legacy public instances, Enterprise instance has no ID value. You do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: LicenseCode
parameters.description: The license type (audio and video specification). Valid values: **480P** and **720P**.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.

You can view the information of all products in the current instance in the IoT Platform console or by calling the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) operation.
